[{"insert":"DB Sumo RDL

The dumbbell sumo RDL uses a wide stance and a soft knee to load your hamstrings, glutes, and inner thighs through a long stretch. Hold the dumbbells close to your legs, push your hips straight back, and lower only as far as you can while keeping a flat back. The 20X0 tempo means a controlled two second lower with no bounce at the bottom, then stand tall and squeeze your glutes. Reps stay at ten across all three sets while the effort climbs, so nudge the weight up each set to match the rising RPE.
"}]
